description: Implementation of a generic message sender class for the Eclipse Hono project, facilitating message sending over AMQP with methods for creation, sending, and closing the sender.

classes.name: GenericMessageSenderImpl
classes.description: A class providing AMQP message sending capabilities for the Hono client, extending AbstractHonoClient and implementing MessageSender.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to asynchronously create a new instance of GenericMessageSenderImpl with specified connection, target address, and close hook.

methods.name: getCredit
methods.description: Returns the current credit available for sending messages.

methods.name: sendQueueDrainHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler to be invoked when the send queue drains.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the sender with a completion handler.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the sender link is open.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message asynchronously and returns a Future of the ProtonDelivery.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for the outcome (accepted or rejected), returning a Future.
